To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) PCD is a common cause of bronchiectasis in Cyprus and (2) PCD patients, especially those who have had a lobectomy in the childhood, may present in adulthood with advanced lung disease.

1) the majority of PCD patients were diagnosed in early life and the diagnosis is often delayed in adulthood, 2) PCD patients who were lobectomized in the past presented with more advanced lung disease in adulthood and 3) the performance of lobectomization seems to have a poor prognostication for PCD in adults.
PCD often remains under-diagnosed up to adult life and that lobectomized PCD adults are at higher risk of having advanced lung disease
